data.body:
[P1] Reconcile native attempts against service history

Attempts are inventoried exclusively from `WRAPPER_ENTER` records; service `InvocationCompleted` records for other request IDs are silently ignored. If an original invocation produces no ledger records and a retry succeeds, `_bind_requests` selects that retry as the original, and this normalizer can publish complete watermarks and passing retirement evidence while omitting the first attempt. Per-request sequence checks cannot detect an entirely missing stream. Reconcile every service-reported request ID against the ledger and launch journal, and mark missing streams incomplete. Add a regression test with a service-recorded original and only the retry present in the ledger.
